notes: External source IDs are provenance/mapping keys, never PostgreSQL primary keys.
Traveler is one combat entity with Aether and Lumine selectable variants and adaptive elemental attunement.
Miliastra Avatar is a separate mode-specific playable entity with Manekin and Manekina variants; it is not an ordinary combat-roster entry.
Supplementary art, profile, build, or tier data is intentionally absent from this manifest.
review_notes: The source index establishes that a record exists in this snapshot; it does not by itself prove playable status. Playable classification uses official release/event-wish evidence.
Sandrone was promoted from candidate to confirmed combat playable after the official July 1, 2026 event-wish notice named her as the limited 5-star rate-up character.
This is a versioned point-in-time snapshot, not a claim that genshin-db is authoritative or exhaustive. Re-review release evidence whenever the source snapshot changes.
The source set does not provide a comprehensive NPC registry; NPCs not represented by an indexed character record are intentionally not enumerated.
Punctuation-only placeholders exposed by the source alias index (including “——” and “???”) are omitted as aliases; they are not character names or searchable aliases.

source_field_policy.source_record_counts_checked: At audit time all source records referenced by the confirmed and candidate manifests contained rarity, elementText, and weaponText. Revalidate each field on every snapshot update.

release_order_policy.strategy: Append after the current maximum release_order in the same serialized transaction; allocate one value per inserted character row.
release_order_policy.existing_seed_values_verified: sql/02_seed_data.sql uses 87 unique values from 1 through 87.
release_order_policy.concurrency_requirement: Serialize catalog writers or take an explicit table lock before reading MAX(release_order).
